svg.title: TF-IDF + Logistic Regression pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Sklearn Pipeline: raw text splits into two parallel TF-IDF vectorizers (word n-grams and char n-grams), their outputs are joined by FeatureUnion, then fed into a Logistic Regression classifier.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the raw input text look like before preprocessing?')
sendPrompt('What does TfidfVectorizer with word ngrams do?')
sendPrompt('What is the output shape of word TF-IDF?')
sendPrompt('What does TfidfVectorizer with char_wb analyzer do?')
sendPrompt('What is the output shape of char TF-IDF?')
sendPrompt('Why use class_weight=balanced in Logistic Regression?')
sendPrompt('What does the final output probability mean?')
